meta.title: About AFAQ Systems — Integrated Engineering Partner
meta.description: Since 2008, AFAQ Systems has delivered integrated engineering across survey, civil and steel, intelligent transportation, and AV — connecting every infrastructure layer for Saudi Vision 2030.

hero.title: Engineering Every Layer of Tomorrow.
hero.subtitle: Since 2008, AFAQ Systems has delivered integrated engineering solutions that bridge the physical and digital worlds. From underground utility mapping to intelligent transportation systems and advanced AV technologies, we transform infrastructure into connected assets that power Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030.

story.title: From the Depths of the Earth to the Heights of Space Technology.
story.lead: AFAQ began as a specialist survey practice and grew, discipline by discipline, into a fully integrated engineering company. Each capability we added connected to the last — until a single partner could carry a project from the first ground measurement to the intelligent systems that run it.
story.imageLabel: Photograph — AFAQ engineering across a decade of Saudi infrastructure
